definition: Best-supported target/control baseline for the requested assay family.
recommended_action: Start here, subject to archive-run resolution and normal QC.

definition: Biologically valuable but affected by perturbation, protocol equivalence, limited replication, unpublished status, or unresolved archive mapping.
recommended_action: Include with an explicit assay/condition covariate or as a separate model head.

definition: Negative-enzyme/background control or outside the requested assay scope.
recommended_action: Retain for QC/background estimation; do not use as positive TSS targets.

definition: Whether a row is a cap-positive target or a negative protocol control.
recommended_action: Train positive profiles only from target rows; use controls to diagnose background.

definition: Library omitted tobacco acid pyrophosphatase or analogous cap-dependent conversion.
recommended_action: Treat as protocol-negative control, not a transcription-start target.

definition: Canonical PRO-cap/ChRO-cap/GRO-cap or a close 5′GRO equivalent.
recommended_action: Use as a batch covariate; consider separate output heads for protocol families.

definition: Confidence level for sample → experiment → run mapping.
recommended_action: Never infer missing SRR/ERR IDs from accession adjacency. Resolve with ENA/NCBI before download.

definition: Direct ENA URL is present only where a run accession was independently resolved.
recommended_action: Check URL availability and MD5 before pipeline ingestion.

definition: Experiment/run query endpoint for rows without a direct FASTQ link.
recommended_action: Open/query this endpoint to obtain run accession, layout, FASTQ path, and MD5.

definition: Deposited processed tracks span mm9/mm10, dm3/dm6, WS230, sacCer3, and TAIR10.
recommended_action: Prefer uniform raw-read reprocessing to mm39, dm6, ce11/WBcel235, sacCer3, or TAIR10 as listed.

definition: PRO-cap-like assays are directional, but R1/R2 conventions vary.
recommended_action: Validate strand orientation at known unidirectional promoters before generating profiles.
Map jointly or sequentially, record spike-in fraction, and exclude spike-in reads from target labels.

definition: Rows intended to be compared/pooled as biological replicates.
recommended_action: Assess replicate concordance before pooling; do not combine distinct conditions as replicates.

definition: Many mature transcripts receive trans-spliced leaders, separating RNA 5′ ends from true initiation sites.
recommended_action: Prefer nascent cap maps for TSS labels and avoid validating solely against mature-RNA annotations.

definition: Convenient for inspection but derived with heterogeneous pipelines and old assemblies.
recommended_action: Use raw reads for a unified modeling benchmark whenever possible.
